newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 14.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

Formulab Nominees Pty Ltd and Formulab International Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Formulab Neuronetics Corporation Limited on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 15,950,000 ordinary shares (5.56%).
- - - - Task Holdings Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Forrestania Gold NL on 11/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 3,787,429 ordinary shares (6.5%).
Carlton & United Breweries Ltd increased its relevant interest in The Ballarat Brewing Company Limited on 12/02/1997, from 25,001,964 ordinary shares (92.27%) to 25,274,528 ordinary shares (93.28%).
Maple-Brown Abbott Ltd increased its relevant interest in PMP Communications Limited on 10/02/1997, from 16,968,262 ordinary shares (7.5%) to 21,421,083 ordinary shares (8.51%).
Hunneric Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Energy Developments Limited on 11/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 4,500,000 ordinary shares (7.1498%).

Stuart-Murphy Industries Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Australian Natural Foods Holdings Limited on 12/02/1997, from 1,671,962 ordinary shares (10.24%) to 2,247,537 ordinary shares (13.76%).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Amcor Limited on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 33,024,191 ordinary shares (5.21%).
Perpetual Trustees Australia Limited decreased its relevant interest in Avatar Industries Limited on 05/02/1997, from 6,066,423 ordinary shares (10.64%) to 5,365,040 ordinary shares (8.25%).
Mercury Asset Management Plc decreased its relevant interest in Forrestania Gold NL on 11/02/1997, from 6,432,609 ordinary shares (13.17%) to 6,344,689 ordinary shares (10.87%).
National Mutual Holdings Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Colly Cotton Limited on 12/02/1997, from 8,045,000 ordinary shares (7.52%) to 6,975,100 ordinary shares (6.52%).
ASC All Ordinaries Index Fund Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in ASC Limited on 12/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,232,760 ordinary shares (14.8%).
JC Holdings Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Union Mining NL on 13/02/1997.
Capital Energy NL decreased its relevant interest in Beach Petroleum NL on 13/02/1997, from 28,000,000 ordinary shares (10.14%) to 20,000,000 ordinary shares (7.25%).
Prolific Asset Management increased its relevant interest in Hartley Poynton Limited from 3,963,740 ordinary shares (11.46%) to 4,200,000 ordinary shares (12.11%).
MB Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Normans Wines Limited on 07/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 1,271,336 ordinary shares (5.29%).
SHL Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Medical Corporation Australasia Limited on 13/02/1997, from 10,250,012 ordinary shares (15.38%) to 10,890,012 ordinary shares (16.34%).
Jimperding Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in United Construction Group Limited on 13/02/1997. - - - -
